investigation_notes.Recent Similar Alert: SOC-11300 — same user, same source IP, same user agent; closed as false positive after client confirmed ChatGPT automated SharePoint synchronization.
investigation_notes.Description: An automated client integration (ChatGPT via Python aiohttp) downloaded 300 SharePoint files from an endpoint in Tallinn, Estonia at 2026-01-05T10:33:46Z. The activity occurred during local business hours and a recent matching alert (SOC-11300) was previously closed as a false positive after client confirmation that ChatGPT was performing scheduled synchronization. Given the geolocation within Europe, the business-hour timing, and validated historical context indicating expected automated sync behavior, this alert is considered Low Priority.
